raw_articles.title: Best Buy names chief fulfillment and operations officer
raw_articles.summary: Duane Scarboro is responsible for sourcing, supply chain, fulfillment, delivery and service in the new role, which went into effect last week.

raw_articles.title: WD-40 hit with 100% spike in some sourcing costs from Iran war
raw_articles.summary: The maintenance and household products maker said effects from the conflict strained its supply chain last quarter.

raw_articles.title: Taylor Farms lettuce didn’t contain parasite behind diarrhea outbreak, FDA says
raw_articles.summary: The agency said a previous finding was “a false positive,” but the supplier to companies such as Walmart and Taco Bell remains at the heart of an ongoing investigation.

raw_articles.title: JM Smucker snags Hershey exec as SVP of operations, supply chain
raw_articles.summary: Douglas Guilherme will step into the role on July 29 with over 30 years of experience, including stints at the chocolate maker and Procter & Gamble.

raw_articles.title: JBS axes 2040 net-zero goal, citing ‘immense’ execution challenges
raw_articles.summary: The meat giant will no longer aim to achieve net-zero greenhouse emissions across its supply chain by 2040 and has also dropped scope 3 reduction targets.
